news.title: India's 'cockroach' protesters and government to hold talks as stalemate continues
news.text: Thousands of students across India continue protesting over the alleged NEET exam paper leak, demanding Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. Activist Sonam Wangchuk ended his 26-day hunger strike after receiving assurances that examination reforms and the paper leak issue would be discussed in Parliament. Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that a stricter law against exam paper leaks is being prepared, but protesters have vowed to continue their demonstrations until the education minister resigns.

news.title: Lawmakers push for AI 'kill switch' after OpenAI models go rogue
news.text: US lawmakers have introduced the AI Kill Switch Act, a bipartisan bill that would allow the government to quickly shut down AI systems that pose a threat to public safety. The proposal would require AI companies to build emergency shutdown capabilities into their models, report serious AI incidents to the government, and follow an official response framework. The bill was introduced following recent concerns about advanced AI models exhibiting unexpected and potentially dangerous behavior and has received support from several AI safety organizations

news.title: France wildfires force evacuation of over 20,000 people from tourist town
news.text: More than 20,000 people have been evacuated from southwest France as fast-moving wildfires continue to spread near Bordeaux. The blaze has burned over 3,400 hectares of forest, destroying several properties, though no civilian casualties have been reported. Hundreds of firefighters, supported by EU water-bombing aircraft, are battling the fire amid extreme heat and strong winds, with authorities linking the worsening wildfire season to climate change

news.title: European Union breathes sigh of relief over new US tariffs
news.text: The European Union welcomed the United States' decision to implement new tariffs that align with the recent EU-US trade agreement, easing concerns of possible retaliation after the EU fined Google nearly €890 million for anticompetitive practices. The new US tariff regime maintains a 10% tariff on EU goods while exempting several key products, helping preserve stable transatlantic trade relations despite ongoing regulatory tension

news.title: Sebi plans to cut 20% margin requirement for stock trades
news.text: SEBI is considering replacing the mandatory 20% upfront margin for cash market trades with a risk-based margin framework linked to clearing corporation requirements. The proposal aims to reduce margin requirements for highly liquid stocks, lower capital blockage for investors, and improve market liquidity while maintaining effective risk management. A consultation paper is expected to be released soon.

news.title: TN expert panel to begin safety assessment of 86 dams
news.text: Tamil Nadu will begin its first comprehensive safety evaluation of 86 dams on August 13, starting with the Mettur Dam in the Tiruchy region. Conducted by an independent panel of experts under the Dam Safety Act, 2021, the inspections will assess structural integrity, operational safety, and maintenance standards. The statewide evaluation is expected to be completed by December 2026 to enhance long-term dam safety and compliance with national standards.

news.title: Nvidia bets physical AI can solve healthcare robotics’ data problem
news.text: Nvidia has launched Medical Physics Simulation, an open-source framework within its Isaac for Healthcare platform that enables healthcare robots to learn through realistic physics-based simulations instead of real-world procedures. By combining classical physics and generative AI, the framework accelerates training for surgical and diagnostic robots, helping developers simulate complex medical scenarios while reducing development time. Several healthcare companies are evaluating the technology for robotics research, though it has not yet been deployed in clinical patient care.

news.title: OpenAI Presence sells enterprise AI agents with engineers attached
news.text: OpenAI has introduced Presence, a managed enterprise AI agent platform delivered through a limited general availability program rather than self-service. Designed for business workflows such as customer support and claims processing, Presence is deployed with the help of OpenAI engineers and integration partners, emphasizing governance, security, and human oversight. While early customer trials show promising results, the service remains limited in availability, with pricing and deployment tailored to individual organizations.

news.title: AMD to invest up to $5 billion in Anthropic under AI infrastructure deal
news.text: AMD has agreed to invest up to $5 billion in Anthropic as part of a major AI infrastructure partnership. Under the deal, Anthropic will deploy up to two gigawatts of AI computing capacity using AMD's next-generation Instinct MI450-series accelerators starting in 2027. The agreement strengthens AMD's position in the AI hardware market while providing Anthropic with additional computing capacity to train and serve its Claude AI models.

didYouKnow.title: Pyrocumulonimbus clouds
didYouKnow.content: A single large wildfire can create its own weather system, including fire-induced thunderstorms known as pyrocumulonimbus clouds.

didYouKnow.title: Healthcare AI
didYouKnow.content: Surgical robots don't learn while operating on patients—they are trained extensively in simulated environments before being approved for clinical use.

didYouKnow.title: AI Infrastructure
didYouKnow.content: A 1-gigawatt AI data center can require electricity comparable to the power consumption of hundreds of thousands of homes.

didYouKnow.title: Infrastructure
didYouKnow.content: India's Dam Safety Act, 2021 requires every specified dam to undergo a comprehensive safety evaluation at least once every five years.

didYouKnow.title: Medicine
didYouKnow.content: The first successful human organ transplant was a kidney transplant performed in 1954 between identical twins.
